verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party capability in the Gemini assistant for seeing and operating desktop applications for the user. The Computer Use tool is a developer API for building your own control agents, which is a building block rather than the assistant doing it. Connected Apps act on content through integrations (e.g., Gmail, Calendar) and do not operate applications on the computer. Android screen help only reads what is on screen and does not operate it.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can let the assistant see and operate applications on my computer to complete work
